messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: Detected elevated 5xxs and p95 latency for inference endpoints in eu-west-1a. Pager: @alice_oncall. Runbook: /runbooks/az-egress-deg.

alice_oncall: acknowledging, joining. seeing errors in dashboard? which services impacted?

bob_sre: confirmed metrics: 12% 5xx rate for /v1/generate in eu-west-1a, p95 token latency up from 180ms -> 640ms. Many connections showing RST/ECONNRESET from a subset of hosts.

carla_prod: customer impact: several PLG apps spiking errors, a few enterprise customers reporting timeouts. CS queue getting tickets.

alice_oncall: tagging the runbook — step 1: check az host health and resolver errors. @david_eng please check route table flaps / host egress counters.

david_eng: looking. netstat/logs show repeated source route propagation mismatch on a single VPC subnet. AWS VPC route-convergence events around 15:12 UTC, coincides with spike. Instances in this subnet show high retransmits. suspect control-plane route flap to the downstream NAT/GW.

bob_sre: running quick query: `SELECT host, count(*) FROM envoy_errors WHERE region='eu-west-1a' AND code like '5%' GROUP BY host ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;` top hosts are inference-worker-az1a-{03,07,12}.

alice_oncall: mitigation plan: (A) divert new traffic to eu-west-1b/c via smart routing policy, (B) mark affected AZ hosts draining, (C) notify customers. Executing A now. ops-bot: run route-policy set region-eu-west-1 prefer=eu-west-1b fallback=eu-west-1a reason="az1a route flap"

ops-bot: OK: route-policy updated, new sessions will prefer eu-west-1b/c. Streaming connections remain sticky.

emily_support: drafting status update for customers: "We are investigating increased errors in eu-west-1a; traffic is being routed to healthy zones; some customers may experience degraded latency. We'll update in 30m." Want me to post? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

carla_prod: yes post now and call out transient errors for 5-10% of requests in that AZ. Offer workaround: set region preference to eu-west-1b if strict SLA.

david_eng: starting targeted remediation on affected hosts: `sudo systemctl restart networking && sudo reboot -f` on inference-worker-az1a-07 (after cordon). Also increasing proxy retry/backoff settings for streaming.

bob_sre: cordon/drain commands issued: `kubectl cordon worker-az1a-07 && kubectl drain worker-az1a-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — pods will reschedule to eu-west-1b.

alice_oncall: monitoring metrics, looking for 5xx drop and p95 improvement. If error rate doesn't fall in 5m, escalate to infra on-call for AWS support case.

ops-bot: Alert: aws-console: VPC event: RoutePropagation state changed for rtb-0a1b2c3d; lastUpdate 2026-03-17T15:12:08Z.

bob_sre: 5m update: 5xx rate down to 3% from 12%, p95 latency back to ~220ms. Partial recovery but still seeing intermittent resets on 2 hosts.

emily_support: posted customer status note and pinned to status page.

carla_prod: tracking tickets — created an incident label, notifying top-20 affected customers directly.

alice_oncall: handing off to @david_eng for ongoing remediation and RCA. I will update postmortem template and schedule follow-up. On-call shift ends in 30m, leaving handoff notes. :white_check_mark:

david_eng: taking over. I'll open an AWS support case for route table propagation anomalies and collect netflows. Adding link to case in incident doc.

alice_oncall: thanks all. If anything spikes, page the on-call rotation. Closing active pager for now, continuing as post-incident investigation.
